claims.statement: Pinned guide spans FPT/GHEC/GHES and distinguishes adding existing issue/PR, creating repository issue and project-only draft. It explicitly permits items from any organization, qualifying narrower creation-guide examples; actual repository/project permissions remain required.
Item limit is 50000 across active and archived at pinned variable; linked auto-archive does not free quota. No destructive removal authority inferred from capacity limit.

Timeline events for add/remove/status changes resolve FPT/GHEC/GHES>=3.19; require at least project read to view and built-in workflow attribution is github-project-automation. Attribution/event presence is not exhaustive audit, caller identity or independent acceptance.
URL paste and repository/title search add selected existing content via bottom row. Exact owner/repository/issue identity is needed; title matches and example URLs are not unique authorization.

Bulk-add selects repository/search/results and Add selected items; repository select-all explicitly covers page, not all pages. Partial filtered selection cannot certify exhaustive repository ingestion.

Issue/PR sidebar Projects selection and optional custom values alter project association/fields, not project access grants. Command palette shortcuts route to same bulk-add procedure, not independent automation coverage.

Create issue modal chooses repository, title, optional assignees/labels/milestone/description/other projects; Create more reopens modal. This creates repository content, with distinct destination visibility and write authority, not mere project draft.

Creating issue within grouped view applies group field value automatically. Filtered/group defaults and stored defaults require conflict/readback review; UI creation does not certify final metadata correctness.

Draft exists only in project and supports title/body/assignees/custom fields; repository/labels/milestone require conversion. Draft must not be reported as repository issue or covered by repository-only assessment.

Assignment/mentions in draft do not notify users unless converted according to source. Draft assignment is not delivery/acknowledgement; conversion notifications and audiences need separate verification.

All referenced add/modal/palette/sidebar fragments including nested bottom-row reviewed. Auto-add remains separate no-backfill operation; source procedures not executed. No issues/drafts created, policy accepted, rights clearance or native receipt.
